sceneConcept: A fully provisional human presentation for the background leader known as Heichuan stands alone against a transparent background. The figure is masculine and androgynous, appears thirty-eight and has straight chin-length black hair, cool grey eyes and an unreadable controlled expression. A plain dark navy long coat hangs open over a charcoal high-neck sweater, straight black trousers and low matte boots. Both arms rest calmly behind the back. Soft even frontal studio light leaves the figure free of public gang coding or supernatural display.
